import numpy as np

print("pilot shape:", X.shape, "label balance:", np.bincount(y.astype(int) + 1))

for thr in (0.3, 0.4, 0.5):
    feats = stab_screen(X, y, thr=thr)
    print(f"stab thr={thr}: keeps {len(feats)} features")
f20 = f_screen(X, y, 20)
print("top20F:", f20+1)
f30 = f_screen(X, y, 30)
print("top30F overlap with stab(0.3):", len(set(f30) & set(stab_screen(X, y, 0.3))))
